questions.question: Institutional Venture Capital typically differs from Angel Investment in / that: a). It involves individuals investing b). questions.question: Exporter A sells perishable goods, Exporter B sells capital equipment. / Which service is more appropriate to Exporter B, and why? A a). Exporter B – forfaiting, because b). Exporter B – Leasing, because perishable goods need fast cash it is for large-ticket items c). Exporter B – forfaiting, because d). Exporter B – factoring, because it matches long-term, high-value it covers political risks receivables
questions.solution_html:
• C:Exporter B – forfaiting, because it matches long-term, high-value receivables

questions.final_answer: Option (c) Exporter B – forfaiting, because it matches long-term, high-value receivables
